prompt: Subject: Forest waterside and floral swimsuit Main Focus: woman in her 20s standing knee-deep in a clear river surrounded by greenery, holding a black snorkel mask in one hand. Large focus on the character placed to the right, featuring the white floral bikini and water ripples. Person/Expression: Slender oval face with small jaw, closed wide eyes, thin eyebrows, small nose, pale coral lips. Head tilted slightly down with a quiet smile and closed eyes. Long dark brown hair in a high ponytail, flowing over her right shoulder, with thin bangs. Clothing/Pose: triangle bikini with orange floral patterns on white background. Clear view of strings at neck, back, and hips. Standing on both legs in water. Right arm bent with hand in hair, left arm extended diagonally down holding a black mask and orange-tipped snorkel. Background/Light: Foreground to center is transparent shallow water reflecting greenery, grey stones and ferns on the opposite bank, dense conifers in the back. Strong direct sunlight from the upper left illuminates skin and water surface, creating fine golden ripples and reflections of legs underwater. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Near full-body portrait taken from a front camera slightly above water level, from top of head to below knees in water. Character placed large on the right half with wide water space on the left, mask near the right edge. Legs shown through water surface and cut at the bottom. Focus on the character with deep depth of field showing the forest. Texture/Style: Photorealistic photo taken in midsummer natural light. High-definition depiction of water droplets on skin, floral pattern on cloth, water transparency, reflecting ripples, and details of leaves and rocks. Negative: Omission of snorkel gear in left hand; do not open closed eyes.

promptZh: 主体：森林水畔与碎花泳装 核心焦点：20 多岁的女性 站在绿意盎然的清澈河流中，水深及膝，一手拿着黑色浮潜面罩。重点刻画位于右侧的人物，展现白色碎花比基尼和水波纹。人物/表情：瘦削的椭圆形脸庞，下颌小巧，双眼紧闭，眉毛细长，鼻子小巧，珊瑚色淡唇。头部微微低垂，带着安静的微笑，双眼闭合。深棕色长发扎成高马尾，垂在右肩上，留着稀疏的刘海。服装/姿势：白色底橙色碎花图案的三角比基尼。清晰可见颈部、背部和臀部的系带。双腿站立在水中。右臂弯曲，手放在头发上，左臂斜向下伸展，拿着黑色面罩和橙色尖端的呼吸管。背景/光线：前景至中心为透明的浅水，倒映着绿植，对岸有灰色石头和蕨类植物，背景是茂密的针叶林。左上方强烈的直射阳光照亮了皮肤和水面，在水下形成细腻的金色波纹和腿部倒影。构图/相机：3:4 竖构图。近全身人像，从水面略上方的前置摄像头拍摄，从头顶到水下膝盖下方。人物主体位于右半部分，左侧留有大面积水域空间，面罩靠近右边缘。双腿透过水面可见，底部截断。聚焦于人物，深景深展现森林背景。纹理/风格：盛夏自然光下的写实照片。高清呈现皮肤上的水珠、布料上的花纹、水的透明度、反射的波纹以及树叶和岩石的细节。负面提示：省略左手中的浮潜装备；不要睁开闭合的双眼。
